title: Early brass bands and the Eureka band
summary: He recalls Excelsior, Tuxedo, Imperial and Silver Leaf bands, then playing E-flat clarinet in the Eureka band.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: No, I don't remember nothing like that. But I remember several brass bands that they had around the city of New Orleans when I was quite a youngster coming up. They had Excelsa brass band and they had Tuxedas brass band. That was time of Papa Celestans. And had the Imperial brass band. Another brass band that I knew, Silverleaf. All that was around Bunk Johnson them times.
Do you remember who were in some of those bands, like the Excelsior, who the leader was?

Well, I don't know who was the leader of the Excelsior, but I did remember some of the fellows that used to play Eno's band. I think Manuel Perez, he was a trumpet player. I know Tuxedas, that was Papa Celestans. And Ada Jackson. The trubor player. Yeah, the sousaphone player. And I just can't think of who I was in the band at the time, but I remember the band when I was quite a young fellow. Now then after late years, then come the Eureka brass band. Well, at that time, I had a fellow playing in that band by the Willie Wilson.
I never knew him. What did he play?
Trumpet. I didn't remember that. Yeah. Never heard of him, huh?
Well, maybe, but I don't remember.
Well then, at that time, Ray had the Eureka band. He used to play trombone. Yeah, I remember
And in this band, Willie Webber used to play trumpet. Jack August used to play saxophone. And I did play the clarinet. Yeah, E-flat clarinet.
